revenue_scope: Chugai Pharmaceutical's 'Domestic' Tarceva sales (Domestic > Oncology rows of the Statements of revenues (QTR)), billions of yen. A single-territory slice (the heading is 'Domestic'); Roche's worldwide line is not the same scope.
why_separate: The gold series is Roche's worldwide Tarceva line and ends 2018Q4. Chugai, a Roche-group company, kept printing a quarterly Tarceva row for its domestic sales through 2019Q4, in yen; it is a narrower territory and a different issuer, so it is not the worldwide series continued.
notes: Rows cover 2019Q1 to 2019Q4 only. Chugai's Q1 FY2020 supplementary materials (and every later deck read, FY2020 to FY2025 first half) carry no Tarceva row; the FY2019 columns restated there show Oncology 'Other products' of 2.1, 2.7, 3.6 and 2.9 against 0.9, 1.3, 2.5 and 1.9 before restatement, consistent with Tarceva having been folded into 'Other products' (inferred from the arithmetic, Chugai states no reason). Chugai's 2019 total is 1.2+1.3+1.0+1.0 = 4.5 billion yen, the figure its Annual Report 2019 prints for Tarceva. Roche's own annual worldwide figures for 2019 and 2020 are in roche_tarceva_cont_annual.csv. Chugai printed the 2018 quarters (1.9, 2.5, 2.1, 1.8) too, but 2018 belongs to the gold series and is not used.
search_log: Chugai supplementary materials for consolidated financial results, files FILE_3_45 to FILE_3_76 on chugai-pharm.co.jp (Q3 FY2018 to the H1 2025 decks), text-searched for a Tarceva row: present Q3 FY2018 to FY2019, absent from Q1 FY2020 onward.
Q1 FY2019 to FY2019 decks (FILE_3_47 to FILE_3_50) read for the Statements of revenues (QTR) Tarceva row; quarter columns 1.2, 1.3, 1.0, 1.0.
Chugai's English 'Revenue by Product' page is an embedded iframe and was not readable; the PDF decks were used instead.

continuation.evidence: Chugai supplementary materials for the 1st quarter of FY2019, Statements of revenues (QTR): 'Tarceva 1.9 2.5 2.1 1.8 1.2 (36.8)' (billions of yen; Q1 2019 = 1.2), the first quarter after the gold series' last quarter 2018Q4 (https://www.chugai-pharm.co.jp/cont_file_dl.php?f=FILE_3_47.pdf&rep=137%2C47&src=%5B%250%5D%2C%5B%251%5D).
